title: CAPITAL ONE FINANCIAL CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: Capital One Financial Corporation filed an 8-K on April 7, 2026, reporting the completion of its acquisition of Brex Inc. for approximately $2.56 billion in cash and 10,646,306 shares of Company common stock. The Board also approved a special RSU award of approximately $2.0 million to Chief Enterprise Services Officer Frank LaPrade for his contributions to completing the transaction.
key_points: Capital One completed acquisition of Brex Inc. on April 7, 2026
Total consideration: approximately $2.56 billion in cash plus 10,646,306 shares of Company Common Stock
Transaction was pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated January 22, 2026
Stock Consideration was issued exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act
Frank LaPrade (Chief Enterprise Services Officer) received 11,041 RSUs with grant date value of approximately $2.0 million
RSUs vest in three equal annual installments and settle 100% in Company Common Stock
